title: Can I BEAT Setup Chess?
summary: Setup Chess: both players take turns placing pieces anywhere on their first three ranks with a 39-point budget (P1 N3 B3 R5 Q9), the king placed last for free; then a normal game is played. He favours rooks/bishops batteries and wins 3/3, concluding bishops are OP.
rules: Placement phase: players alternate placing one piece at a time anywhere on their own first three ranks.
Budget 39 points per side (pawn 1, knight 3, bishop 3, rook 5, queen 9); king must also be placed (free).
Placing the king can be delayed to the end so the opponent cannot target it.
After both armies are placed, normal chess is played; White moves first (the player who finished placing first gets to move - 13:14 'he does get to move first').
setup: Empty board; drafting phase on ranks 1-3 (White) and 6-8 (Black).
current_impl_issues: Current impl 'drafts' armies automatically; video has alternating interactive placement one piece at a time, with opponent seeing each placement. King placed by player choice.

current_impl.explain: Both armies are drafted from 39 points and placed on the first three ranks. Then play normal chess and checkmate the bot.

evidence: 0:01 '39 points... first three ranks'; 0:34 alternating placement; 1:59 'only has enough points for one more queen'; 13:14/14:07 king placed last.
